evidence: src/domain/entities/Order.ts: class Order with private constructor, static place/restore, toSnapshot(); delegates transition rules to canTransition from ../value-objects/OrderStatus

src/domain/entities/Product.ts: class Product with private constructor, static create/restore, toSnapshot(); create() delegates to restore() so the stock rules (requireNonNegativeInteger, reserved <= onHand) live in one place

Both files use the shared guards (requireNonEmpty, requireNonNegativeInteger) and the typed errors from ../errors/DomainError (InvalidValueError, InvalidOrderTransitionError, InsufficientStockError, StockAccountingError)
Product.reserve reuses canReserve, and release/commit share the private requireReserved, so no check is repeated
Order.totalCents adds up OrderLine.subtotalCents rather than recalculating price × quantity
Minor inconsistency: Order.restore skips the checks in Order.place (non-empty ids, at least one line, no duplicate productId), while Product.restore runs its checks
